findings.title: Migration crashes with IndexError when embed_category or uncategorized_category_id is not in site_settings
findings.body: Lines 9-11 and 15 index directly into the `PG::Result` returned by `execute` (`execute(...)[0]['id']` and `execute(...)[0]['value']`) without checking `cmd_tuples > 0`. On any database where `embed_category` was not saved in `site_settings` (the common case, and always true on a fresh database before seeds run), the query returns 0 rows and `result[0]` raises `IndexError: Index 0 is out of range`, aborting `db:migrate`.

findings.title: Migrated embeddable_hosts are inserted without normalizing URLs or escaping SQL
findings.body: The previous `embeddable_hosts` site setting allowed full URLs with schemes and paths (e.g. `http://discourse.org` or `https://example.com/1234`), which `EmbeddableHost` normally strips in a `before_validation` callback. Because the migration inserts raw lines via SQL (`VALUES ('#{h}', ...)`), any existing host entries containing a scheme or path will be stored un-normalized and will fail to match `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host` (which compares `lower(host)` against `uri.host`). Interpolating `h` directly into SQL can also break the migration if the setting contains single quotes.

findings.title: before_validation raises NoMethodError when host is nil
findings.body: In the `before_validation` callback, `self.host.sub!` is called unconditionally. If `host` is `nil` (for example `EmbeddableHost.new.valid?` or a request with a missing `:host` param), calling `.sub!` on `nil` raises `NoMethodError` instead of adding a validation error.

findings.title: record_for_host returns false on invalid input, fails on uppercase hosts, and ignores ports
findings.body:
`EmbeddableHost.record_for_host` has three issues:
1. It returns `false` on lines 12 and 15 when `uri` or `uri.host` is blank, instead of `nil`. In `TopicEmbed.import` (`app/models/topic_embed.rb:43`), the return value is used as `eh.try(:category_id)`. In ActiveSupport, `Object#try` only short-circuits on `nil`; calling `false.try(:category_id)` raises `NoMethodError: undefined method 'category_id' for false:FalseClass`.
2. `URI(host).host` preserves the case of the input string, so `where("lower(host) = ?", host)` will fail to match if the URL's hostname contains uppercase letters (`host.downcase` is needed).
3. The validation regex on line 2 allows port numbers (`(:[0-9]{1,5})?`) and `before_validation` keeps them in `self.host`, but `uri.host` strips the port, so a host saved with a port (e.g. `example.com:8080`) will never match in `record_for_host`.

findings.title: Saving a new host without selecting a category leaves host.category undefined in the UI
findings.body: When creating a new `embeddable-host`, `edit()` is not called, so `this.get('categoryId')` is `null` unless the user explicitly changes the category chooser. When `save()` succeeds, the server defaults blank `category_id` to `SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id` and returns it in the payload, which `host.save(props)` applies to `host.category_id`. However, line 38 then sets `host.set('category', Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId')))` using the component's `null` `categoryId` instead of `host.get('category_id')` (or `Discourse.Site.currentProp('uncategorized_category_id')`), leaving `host.category` as `undefined` and hiding the category badge until the page is reloaded.

findings.title: Contents of category_fabricator.rb and embeddable_host_fabricator.rb are swapped
findings.body: `spec/fabricators/category_fabricator.rb` was overwritten with `Fabricator(:embeddable_host)`, while all the category fabricators (`:category`, `:diff_category`, `:happy_category`, `:private_category`) were placed in `spec/fabricators/embeddable_host_fabricator.rb`.

findings.title: Spec 'is false if embeddable_host is blank' no longer tests embeddable_host presence
findings.body: `Topic#expandable_first_post?` (`app/models/topic.rb:868`) was changed to `SiteSetting.embed_truncate? && has_topic_embed?` and no longer checks whether any `EmbeddableHost` exists. In `spec/models/topic_spec.rb`, the `it "is false if embeddable_host is blank"` example was moved outside the `before` block where `SiteSetting.embed_truncate = true` and `topic.stubs(:has_topic_embed?).returns(true)` are set, so it only passes because `embed_truncate` and `has_topic_embed?` default to `false`.
